frames.headline: The Friday Scramble Has A Pattern
frames.sub: It always starts with a gauge instead of a calendar.
list: Tank hits a quarter on Thursday
Nobody orders until it is urgent
The premium is paid on Friday
frames.kicker: DM "DIESEL" to set a standing order.

frames.headline: You Should Not Have To Take Anyone's Word For It
The First Sixty Seconds On A Hard Shoulder
frames.sub: Most people get out of the car. That is the error.
list: Stay belted until you are off the carriageway
Exit on the kerb side only
frames.kicker: Save this before you need it.

frames.headline: A Pothole Does Not Warn You
frames.sub: Lagos replaced 1,200 vehicle suspensions last year. Nobody scheduled any of them.
